articles.title: Swimmer killed in shark attack off popular Western Australia beach - foxweather.com
articles.description: At approximately 10:30 a.m. local time, emergency services were called to a reported shark-related incident in the water off Sorrento Beach.
articles.content:
JOONDALUP, Australia – A swimmer was killed by a shark while swimming off a popular beach in Western Australia on Friday.
